title: Update stale source-ingest API and market admission tests
objective: Align stale source-ingest API, scheduler, and market admission tests with deliberate production changes (tenant-scoped read auth, operator-stop schedule guard, required snapshot market field, and mocked social fetch) without altering production code.

owned: services/source_ingestion/tests/test_scheduled_connector.py: Set PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET in fixture, default tenant_id to tenant-a on test connectors, supply tenant-scoped bearer headers on source-records GETs, and update disabled_connector exclusive-scope test to schedule an enabled connector before stopping it via PUT /lifecycle.

services/source_ingestion/tests/test_external_source_connectors.py: Set PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET in _source_ingest_client fixture, supply tenant_id in connector metadata and _read_headers() on source-records and evidence/bundles GETs, and add tenant_id to search query access_context.

services/source_ingestion/tests/test_latest_market_snapshot_state.py: Update test_paper_signal_producer_rejects_missing_market_context_fail_closed and test_stored_marketless_spy_snapshot_becomes_market_bearing_and_admits_producer to assert market_input_missing with 'market' named in the detail, while preserving proof of subsequent market-bearing admission.

services/source_ingestion/tests/test_provider_management_coverage.py: Mock open_external_url for TDCC, TAIFEX, and StockTwits provider-owned adapter fetches in test_provider_owned_adapters_execute_bounded_fetches_when_payload_omitted, mirroring the existing FMP step so the test runs completely offline without external network dependency.
not_changing: services/source_ingestion/routers/ingest_operations.py: Unmodified; tenant read auth and operator stop schedule checks remain intact.
services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py: Unmodified; scheduler exclusive-scope enforcement remains intact.
services/execution/market_snapshot_admission.py: Unmodified; market required field check in admit_market_snapshot remains intact.
composes_with: Tenant-scoped source read auth introduced in 74f1f8386 (RANKING-OWNER-READ-AUTH-SEAMS-20261004).
Canonical market snapshot admission introduced in c0656a1ff (DEV-PREREQUISITE-CANONICAL-SOURCE-AUTHORITY-20261008).

implementation.root_cause: Tests in services/source_ingestion/tests drifted from production behavior following three deliberate architectural changes merged without CI running the source_ingestion test suite: (1) 74f1f8386 required tenant-scoped bearer authentication for private source GET endpoints; (2) 67382fcf4 rejected PUT /schedule for connectors with active operator stops; (3) c0656a1ff made 'market' a required field in admit_market_snapshot, returning market_input_missing before reaching market_context_missing; additionally, unmocked TDCC, TAIFEX, and StockTwits HTTP fetches encountered live network dependencies and Cloudflare 403 blocks.

deciding_commits.detail: Private source-records and evidence bundle GET endpoints enforce tenant authorization against tenant-owned records. Test fixtures now provision PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET, tag test connectors with tenant_id, send _read_headers() on read endpoints, and supply tenant_id in search access_context.

PUT /connectors/{id}/schedule refuses configuration while an operator stop is active. The disabled connector exclusive-scope test now registers an enabled connector, sets its schedule, and then disables it via PUT /lifecycle, verifying fail-closed execution.

admit_market_snapshot requires 'market' as a mandatory snapshot field, failing closed with code 'market_input_missing' and naming 'market' in the detail. Market tests now expect market_input_missing and preserve the proof that subsequent market-bearing records admit the producer.

implementation.solution: Updated only the four test files to match canonical production expectations and mocked the TDCC, TAIFEX, and StockTwits external network requests so provider coverage runs offline. Zero production files modified.
